$comment: Daily morning hero queue. Each entry has a date; the homepage picks the entry matching today and renders it as the LEAD. Falls back to ship-or-block lead when no entry for today. Generate the image with Codex image_gen (~10s), save to public/bar/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.png, append an entry here with editorial copy. New entries go at the top; older entries stay in the file for the record (and for a /bar/daily/[date] route in a future PR).

posts.kicker: FRIDAY · BLUE HOUR · CLOSING ON THE WEEK
posts.title: Anticipation lives in the blue hour.
posts.body: The hour between sunset and night, when the sky goes from coral to deep blue and the first stars start to show. Refinery flares glowing orange against the dark towers, house windows just starting to light up, ocean turning violet on the wave crests. The street lamps come on. Whatever you've been working on — this is the hour to wrap it, or hand it off, or just go to /drum and tap the room.
posts.imageAlt: El Segundo at blue hour — pixel-art panorama, refinery silhouetted against pink-to-blue sky, first stars appearing, lights coming on

posts.title: The hour where everything looks expensive.
posts.body: Late afternoon in El Segundo. Sun lower in the sky, casting long shadows from the refinery towers across the street. Palm fronds backlit, ocean glittering with white sun-paths, jet contrails crossing overhead. This is the SoCal light people moved here for. Take it personally — go for a /walk, look out the /window, or just sit somewhere with the light hitting your face.
posts.imageAlt: El Segundo in late afternoon golden hour — long shadows from refinery towers, palm fronds catching sun, ocean glittering

posts.title: Clear day. The whole coast is visible.
posts.body: After Tuesday's overcast, today opens up. Crisp blue sky with fluffy white clouds, hard sunlight casting sharp shadows from refinery towers, ocean a clean cobalt with white wave crests. The kind of day El Segundo is famous for. Best day this week for a beach walk, a long pour at /coffee, or just looking at /tide.
posts.imageAlt: El Segundo on a clear Wednesday morning — refinery, residential, palms, sparkling ocean — bright blue sky with fluffy clouds

posts.title: Start with the golden-hour bar.
posts.body: The top of the homepage should feel good to visit. It now opens on the warm bar direction, then gives you three simple doors: open the live bar, tap the drum, or play the arcade. The mood board is still here, but the first move is lighter.
posts.imageAlt: El Segundo at golden hour in pixel art, with warm beach light and a bright coastline
